facts.fact: Presidential Ordonnance n° 26/033 of 16 May 2026, in force on signature, organises the Agence Nationale de Cybersécurité (ANCY) as a public body and the national authority for cybersecurity and information-system security, under the President, and tasks it with setting up a national SOC and CERT/CSIRT.

Article 4 of the ordonnance requires public institutions and operators of vital importance to inform ANCY of all attacks and intrusions; Article 3 also tasks ANCY with identifying such operators with ministries and sector regulators.
